title: The Wool Left Where It Lay

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A thing set down once is a keeping. Set it down twice and it is a way, and a way wants a hand to walk it.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house, told to the fire at the going of the light

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and seventy-five to three hundred and seventy-seven days, six months and one hundred and ninety-five to one hundred and ninety-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 107 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break and no tagged memory. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it now holding the fold of wool Sella left there on the fifteenth and found where put on all three mornings, with no second fold, no third crust and no name spoken over it; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the deep winter's middle tend as three ordinary days: the kiln in its winter rhythm, the river under its skin, the yard going around its seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest, the hearth grammar at both ends, the twice-mended pot kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain covered and unfigured. The chapter's test is the keeping: found where put on the morning of the sixteenth and on the two mornings after, added to no second fold, no name, no third crust, no gift, no payment and no payer. A second keeping would be a habit and a third a way, and both want a payer where none stands. Ilva keeps her firings in wood at the well with no tenth hand; Hessa takes the road with the writing turned toward herself and unread; Berr's box stays up the clay road with the key in a coat pocket. The hand answers six times, the three hundred and twenty-fifth through the three hundred and thirtieth, and the count reaches three hundred and seventy-seven exact. Nothing is opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended. Forward, not closed.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: Found Where It Was Put
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{375}{Stone 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof with the hand laid flat on answer 324 and the count exact at 374 carried forward, then the morning of the first day after the keeping. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. No recap of Stone 13, 14 or 15: nothing from the keeping, the Drawing or the tenth reading crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the test. The surgeon takes the body in the old order and finds the wool folded once in the crust's empty place exactly where it was put — not a second fold, not a third crust, no name spoken over the place, no look toward his face — and files the keeping on a place of its own beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place, gathered once and not made again. The infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing; the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth is made due. The hand takes its small intake on the river's note under the finger's-width door and files answer 325, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment. Last image: the wool lying folded once in the empty place beside the leathery crust with its corner a hair off the wool, no second fold and no name, the count at 375 exact and told by nobody.

scenes.title: The Seven Places
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 16 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper, Ilva once at the yard well; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with kindling and two fence-menders. No Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the household's whole arithmetic is present and none of it stands up and calls itself an account, and the keeping is not made a second time. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out; the gone white frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the river's skin is found where put beside water-over-water, not a fourth covering, not a sixth low thing, not spent on any date (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she does not scrub out; her hand goes to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. The notched birch strip is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined, no figure comes off the wood, and the boy files her order of reaching as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files no tenth, makes no reader of her keeping and joins her to none (T080). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, passes over the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting as a man passes over tools put back where they belong and makes neither again, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, sends three or more men unnamed low into the back room before first grey with no name and no word that the room is cold, and lets his bent finger lead at the cold damper without leaving the holding of Ash 26 a second time; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face — and does not tuck a second fold into the empty place. Her hand does only what the setting needs and goes away. The boy files the keeping found where put and not made again, expressly not a habit, a way, a sign, a gift, a payment or a rule, with no payer standing. In the small hours the hand comes down on answer 326. Last image: the hand laid flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the wool still folded once in the empty place and no second fold, count 375 exact.

scenes.title: A Second Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{376}{Stone 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail roof into a wholly ordinary morning, with the hand laid flat on answer 326 and the count exact at 375 carried forward and not spent. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice. New day, new date and no recap: nothing from Stone 16 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: prove that finding the keeping a second time is not a second keeping — a hand that finds is not a hand that places, and a habit would want a second placing where none stands. Open on the surgeon's inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the wool folded once in the empty place beside it, found where put and changed by nobody in the night; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella's morning grammar: hearth before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it where another woman would say I, a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings and no eighth opening is made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). The hand takes its small intake on the river's note under its winter skin and files answer 327. Last image: the boy's hand outside the wool come up an inch toward the crust's empty place and not reaching, coming straight down again; the wool lies folded once and unchanged, the count at 376 exact.

scenes.title: The Runner's Road
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 17 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper; Hessa Rale as a single road sighting going up the clay road; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man, a woman with kindling and two fence-menders. No Ilva, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the three Ash directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: a carrier passes with a record she will not read, and the boy refuses to join sighting to saying. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place, keeps the three coverings as weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and finds the river's skin where put beside water-over-water, not spent on any date (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). In the afternoon Hessa Rale goes up the clay road in the boy's sight with Berr Clay's narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned toward her own sleeve, the second strap let out for the long road, dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt; the small flat correction of the strap and the turn of the wrist come first, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the yard, nothing pressing where the writing is. To the question put she answers in the grammar of the road that she carries and does not read, and gives no figure and no look into the basket. The boy files the turning of the writing toward herself on a place of its own beside the Ash 6 sighting with a finger between: a runner going up the road with the writing toward herself is not a voice standing in a doorway and not a saying fulfilled; he makes no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no witness, no reader and no payment, joins her neither to Ilva's strip, Berr's thumb, the charcoal, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate nor any other private keeping, and her eighth record-first hand stays eight with no tenth (T080). Tarn and Jorra keep their exact accounts as on the sixteenth — six and the seventh, checked keepings not made again, the remembered ninth stopping with no tenth and the loan uncalled; dusty forearms parted as clot from vessel, the withheld note, the damper's two bites and Ash 26 not repeated, promise ungiven, he's not Vail sealed (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031). Four rooms keep the same gap in their count and are held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four, and no such hand standing (T081). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed, rights the fold without a look at his face and still does not add a second fold; in the small hours the hand comes down on answer 328, filed on the sixth place. Last image: Hessa's slate going up the clay road with the writing turned to her sleeve, the boy not making a reader of her and the keeping at the fold still folded once and unnamed; at the close the hand laid flat on answer 328, count 376 exact.

scenes.title: The Third Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{377}{Stone 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: small hours under the Vail roof into the third ordinary tending morning, with the hand laid flat on answer 328 and the count exact at 376 carried forward and not spent. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice. New day, new date and no recap: nothing from Stone 16 or 17 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the keeping has lasted three days and is still a keeping, not a habit; a habit would want a fourth and none came. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — the leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, the wool folded once in the empty place beside it and found where put a third time with no second fold, no third crust and no name, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077). The hand takes its small intake on the river's note under its winter skin and files answer 329. Last image: the wool folded once in the empty place beside the crust gone harder and browner in the dry cold, the thread frozen and unwiped, the count at 377 exact, six months and one hundred and ninety-seven days told by nobody.

scenes.title: What the Keeping Kept
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 18, the yard going around its places, the kindling and the damper checked, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed under the Vail roof, and the small hours at the very end of the day with the file out on the towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn and Jorra Vail in the afternoon; Garl in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: check every object and find every gap left gap, and let the keeping gather interest without being paid. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere and the river's skin stays on its own place beside water-over-water, found where put and not spent (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the kindling Tarn keeps six and the seventh beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where they were put and makes neither again, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and does not look along the road (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note three turns ahead, and lets his bent finger lead at the cold damper without leaving the holding of Ash 26 a second time; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). **The keeping, advanced and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):** at the going of the light she sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the wool folded once in the crust's empty place exactly where she put it on the fifteenth — no second fold, no third crust, no name, no gift, no payment, no payer, gathered once, found where put on three mornings and three goings of the light and not made again; the boy files it beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place, with a finger between it and every other, and it does not stand up and call itself a habit or a rule. In the small hours the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap: three hundred and twenty-nine honest answers on the sixth place and the three hundred and thirtieth to come; the five objects with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them; the keeping at the fold found where put and not made again; the ninth record-first hand with no tenth; the nine stoppings with no tenth; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings with no witness; the four rooms' gap held apart; ten arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of ten; the river's winter skin beside water over water, found where put and not spent; the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn and the loan uncalled. Nothing is lifted out of its place to make a row come out even and no payer stands under any of them. The hand takes its small intake on the river's note under the finger's-width door, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and lays itself flat against the fold on answer 330, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. Last image: the boy on his bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf, the crust's corner standing a hair off the wool, the wool folded once in the empty place beside it with no name spoken over it, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform; count three hundred and seventy-seven exact, six months and one hundred and ninety-seven days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number; Stone kept its eighteenth day without a boundary drawn and the count goes on under the Vail roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath. Forward, not closed — Stone 20's eleventh arithmetic stands two mornings off and was not brought into these three days.
